excerpt: On April 28, the 1 km-long detector line P-ONE-1 was fully assembled and integrated, representing the culmination of nearly three years of coordinated international development and engineering efforts. ... deploy P-ONE-1 ... by the end of August 2026. ... Final assembly and system testing of the Demonstrator detector lines are expected to take place at TRIUMF between 2027 and 2028.
title: Completed integration of first detector line P-ONE-1 (P-ONE news, May 2026)
